meta.strategy: Social Proof based on Brand Voice

content.headline: The People Powering the Shift
content.subhead: HECTOR is more than a bike; it is the new standard for European urban mobility, trusted by the leaders of the green transition.

testimonials.name: Julianne Moreau
testimonials.title: Logistics Lead
testimonials.quote: HECTOR didn't just give us a bike; they gave our fleet a sustainable pulse that actually fits our operational budget without sacrifice.
testimonials.image_prompt: High-end professional business portrait of a woman in her 40s, logistics executive, natural lighting, blurred Paris modern office background, soft shadows, 85mm lens, corporate style.

testimonials.name: Erik Sorenson
testimonials.title: Urban Planner
testimonials.quote: Finally, an electric bike that performs like a premium EV without the exclusionary price tag. It is the missing link in modern city transit.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional portrait of a middle-aged man with glasses, sophisticated urban planner, minimalist clean light grey background, sharp focus, high-end photography, cinematic lighting.

testimonials.name: Matteo Rossi
testimonials.title: Founder
testimonials.quote: We've swapped our short-range vans for HECTOR bikes, and the efficiency gains in dense city traffic have been absolutely staggering.
testimonials.image_prompt: Confident Italian entrepreneur in his 30s, candid professional look, blurred Milan street background with warm sunlight, high resolution, commercial lifestyle photography.

testimonials.name: Elena Fischer
testimonials.title: Sustainability Consultant
testimonials.quote: The HECTOR mission is clear: clean energy is no longer a luxury reserved for the few, it is a standard that everyone in Europe can now afford.
testimonials.image_prompt: Close-up portrait of a professional woman, modern tech environment, soft bokeh, intelligent expression, high-end executive headshot, neutral color palette.
